description: Plain-language privacy policy for East Bay Insulation: what the estimate form collects, how we use it, and how to ask us to delete your information.
intro: This policy explains, in plain language, what information we collect through our estimate form, how we use it, and how you can ask us to remove it. We keep it simple because we do not do anything complicated with your data.

paragraphs: When you submit the estimate form, we receive the details you enter. That is all we collect through this site.
bullets: Email address, if you provide one

paragraphs: We use your information to respond to your request: to call you back, schedule the inspection and prepare your estimate. That is the only use.
bullets: We never sell or share your information

paragraphs: You can ask us to delete your information at any time. Contact us through the estimate form and tell us what to remove, and we will take care of it.
bullets: Ask what we hold about you
Opt out of any follow-up contact
